findings.summary: Capability-level checks for CAP-ra-polish / CAP-ra-report-center were not run here (integration evidence): pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/confidenceText.test.ts, pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/result.spec.ts tests/e2e/report.spec.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts, and the Play dev-link walkthrough. They depend on sibling tests and the integrated build.
ESLint is not installed in the project (pnpm exec eslint: command not found), so no lint ran on the changed files; tsc is the only static check.

evidence.check: grep -rln ExportReportDialog src shared server tests
evidence.detail: no matches (grep exit 1); the file is deleted and nothing imports it
ConfidenceNote and ResultHeader meta line use formatConfidenceStatement from shared/format/confidenceText.ts ('itens' always); the local describeConfidence was removed

RiskList labels 'Probabilidade P de 5', 'Impacto I de 5', 'Nota P × I = N' use whitespace-nowrap; the label column at sm+ grew from 140px to 160px so the longest label fits; at 390 px the labels wrap between each other (flex-wrap)

Result header: 'Relatórios' link (data-aioson-id result-reports) to #/empresa/{companyId}/relatorios?diagnostico={diagnosisId}; 'Exportar PDF' metal button via ReportDelivery onExport=exportReport(diagnosisId) (default options); after saving, a 'Fechar' button (result-export-close) remounts ReportDelivery so the saved message stays until closed. OwnerHome header has a 'Relatórios' link (home-reports) to #/empresa/{companyId}/relatorios

messages.text: Result screen selectors for tests/e2e/result.spec.ts: the 'Relatórios' link is data-aioson-id=result-reports; 'Exportar PDF' is ReportDelivery's button data-aioson-id=report-export (not the prototype's result-pdf); the saved panel is report-pdf-saved; the close button is result-export-close and appears only after a successful save. OwnerHome link is home-reports.

Still to run after integration: pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/confidenceText.test.ts; pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/result.spec.ts tests/e2e/report.spec.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts (390 px and 1280 px for AC-ra-24 and AC-ra-61); then the Play dev-link walkthrough: result -> Exportar PDF -> PDF salvo -> Fechar, and result/home -> Relatórios opens the center on the right diagnosis.
ConfidenceNote no longer exports describeConfidence; use formatConfidenceStatement from shared/format/confidenceText.ts. ExportReportDialog.tsx is retired.
